def solution():
    # Define spot rates and periods
    spot_rate_2_year = 0.025
    spot_rate_4_year = 0.055
    period_2_year = 2
    period_4_year = 4

    # Calculate the two-year forward rate starting two years from now
    forward_rate = (
        ((1 + spot_rate_4_year) ** period_4_year)
        / ((1 + spot_rate_2_year) ** period_2_year)
    ) ** (1 / (period_4_year - period_2_year)) - 1

    # Return the rate as a percentage, rounded to three decimal places
    return round(forward_rate * 100, 3)
